title: Neutral double support
purpose: Reference posture with both feet flat, every rotary axis at zero and both grippers at the 10 mm open reference.
authority: NO POWERED TEST, MOTION OR ENERGIZATION AUTHORITY

title: Crouched double support
purpose: Symmetric 8/16/8 degree sagittal flexion for stand preparation and vertical compliance development.
authority: NO POWERED TEST, MOTION OR ENERGIZATION AUTHORITY

title: Left weight transfer
purpose: Translate the pelvis toward the left foot while both soles remain nominally flat; no foot lift.
authority: NO POWERED TEST, MOTION OR ENERGIZATION AUTHORITY

title: Right foot lift
purpose: Transfer over the left foot, then command a nominal sub-10 mm right-foot lift without forward placement.
authority: NO POWERED TEST, MOTION OR ENERGIZATION AUTHORITY

title: Right capture-step candidate
purpose: A guarded first forward placement target constrained to the 50 mm development class.
authority: NO POWERED TEST, MOTION OR ENERGIZATION AUTHORITY

title: Right 40 mm touchdown
purpose: A double-support landing configuration with both feet nominally flat and the right sole advanced 40 mm.
authority: NO POWERED TEST, MOTION OR ENERGIZATION AUTHORITY

title: Right weight transfer
purpose: Mirror the lateral whole-body transfer over the right foot while both soles remain nominally flat; no foot lift.
authority: NO POWERED TEST, MOTION OR ENERGIZATION AUTHORITY

title: Left foot lift
purpose: Mirror the restrained lift candidate over the right foot with a nominal sub-10 mm left-foot clearance and no forward placement.
authority: NO POWERED TEST, MOTION OR ENERGIZATION AUTHORITY

title: Left capture-step candidate
purpose: Mirror the guarded forward placement target so both leg chains have complete lift and capture references.
authority: NO POWERED TEST, MOTION OR ENERGIZATION AUTHORITY

title: Left 40 mm touchdown
purpose: The mirrored double-support landing configuration with both feet nominally flat and the left sole advanced 40 mm.
authority: NO POWERED TEST, MOTION OR ENERGIZATION AUTHORITY
